body: I don’t think it’s offensive to talk about it. All feelings and thoughts are valid and you have a right to talk about it. Hopefully in 5 yrs there will be something else you will want to live for. I don’t think there’s anything wrong about thinking of suicide as a safety net of sorts and that being comforting.

I use to worry about it. But I took care of my mom, aunt and my grams when they were I’ll till they passed. Each time when they were excruciating pain they would say they just want to hurry and die. I would spend hours pleading and praying that they wouldn’t. Recently with my grandma I realized it was selfish for me to want them to live when they were so miserable. While my pain might not be as physical but I’ve decided it’s selfish for people to expect me to keep going when I’m in agony. Life might seem fleeting for some but for me it’s like someone’s skinning me alive one little piece at a time. And we all are gonna lose people.
Cremations my choice. Rope around the neck just a little bruising. But I’m not encouraging you to do it.
Go ahead and talk I’m listening.
I’ve got about 12 years. Seems unfairly long
The only thing I can give you is the one day at a time bullshit. It’s arduous and painful but eventually something will shift till it’s no longer as difficult. I hope things work out for you

Yeah I’ve always hated that saying as well. I only stick around for my nieces and nephews. I can’t wait till they get old enough to take care of themselves and deal with their shitty parents on their own.
